definitions.ask: When two of a day's themes share a hue, should the theme lane paint the smaller ones in lighter shades of it?
definitions.why: Real days collide (PYPI/READ green, BLOG/VIBE orange on 10-23); shades keep the hue family

choices.label: Largest keeps the exact hue; smaller same-hue themes get 65 % then 42 % shades
Every segment wears its exact hue; only gaps, legend, and theme pins tell them apart

definitions.ask: Should the Day Strip and Root Parent glossary strands describe the strip's two bars?
definitions.corrects: the full-width root-parent bar that separates it from the badges
